notes: v2.5.13 — required update. Sourcing & Stock: units are handled consistently end to end, stock can be consumed and corrected more safely, and parts that were arriving untracked are now caught and classified at receiving. Purchasing: receiving understands part classes, purchase orders are easier to search and read, and everyone sees the same live totals without refreshing. Operations Intelligence: the Debriefing page is now Global Activity — rebuilt as self-contained cards with a jump-to-section menu, details that open in a window instead of pushing the page around, and a clearer date summary. People are now reported by name everywhere instead of employee codes. Client POs: the pending-approval list is rebuilt so each PO reads as a card, with the document, upload date, uploader and part called out separately. Engineering changes: creating an ECN inside a project works again, and ECNs can be linked to a build. Quotes & projects: sort and filter on the Quotes, ECN and Client PO lists, quote timeline and file panels, deleted quote files can be restored, and Ship Date fills in automatically and appears on the Builds tab. Workforce: project-wide budgeted hours are no longer missing from build and overall totals, and the shutdown and working calendar is editable and feeds the date maths. Travellers: a focused traveller view, CATIA opened straight from a traveller, and ECN drawings opened into a live CATIA session. Plus quality and AS9100 updates, MS Project schedule import, document and file handling fixes, access and permission changes, shop-floor updates, more CATIA remote-viewing work, and a broad look-and-feel pass. This release also updates the database behind AOS, so older versions will not work correctly against it — please update as soon as you are prompted.
